scope: Verify core generated NOD/IMAGE dictionary and plan-bound IMAGEDEF OBJECTS rollback, same-writer retry, and typed reference readback at every calibrated allocation point.

behavior: The generated graph has a NOD entry targeting a source IMAGE dictionary and an IMAGE dictionary entry targeting a plan-bound IMAGEDEF. The IMAGE entity binds to that definition by import generation and source handle.

The test applies explicit output remaps to NOD, IMAGE dictionary, and IMAGEDEF identities, calibrates core OBJECTS allocations after IMAGE entity emission, and injects a one-shot failure at every measured offset in ASCII and Binary output.
Every injected failure occurs before the consumer OBJECTS callback, preserves the destination sentinel, and clears derived written-object and minted-entity identity maps.

After each failure, the same writer retries. Typed import verifies the root NOD entry and owner, IMAGE dictionary owner and key, dictionary-to-IMAGEDEF handle, IMAGE entity reference, and retained IMAGEDEF name.

The test writes temporary generated DXFs under the system temporary directory and removes them on completion; it adds no repository fixture and does not establish external producer behavior or semantic support.

limitations: This exercises one generated IMAGE dictionary and IMAGEDEF graph; it does not qualify source DWG framing, native raster display, or other IMAGE profiles.
Local generated ASCII/Binary readback is transaction and model-binding evidence only; platform qualification and independent semantic support evidence remain open.
next: Continue the P6 safety audit for other OBJECTS builders, source lifetime, platform numeric/string policies, and scoped concurrency.
